models.name: multi_user_todo_guests
models.description: Guest actor records for unauthenticated visitors with device-based identification. This table stores user accounts for guests who have registered with email and password credentials. Once authenticated, guests transition to the member actor role. Each guest owns their private todo items and can manage their account through profile editing, password changes, and account deletion. The session table {@link multi_user_todo_guest_sessions} tracks active login sessions for each guest.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Unique email address for account identification and authentication.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Bcrypt hashed password for secure authentication.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Optional display name shown to the user in the application.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the guest account was soft deleted. Null indicates active account.

models.name: multi_user_todo_guest_sessions
models.description: Temporary session tokens for guest access with device fingerprint tracking. This table records connection metadata and temporal information for each guest session, enabling session management, expiration tracking, and security auditing. Sessions are created upon guest login and terminated on logout or expiration.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address for session tracking and security auditing.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Current page or endpoint URL where the session was established.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referring URL from which the user navigated to establish this session.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp. Marks when the guest logged in.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Session last update timestamp. Tracks session modification events.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp. Sessions are automatically invalidated after this time.

models.name: multi_user_todo_members
models.description: Member actor records with email/password authentication credentials and profile data. This table represents authenticated users who can manage their private todos, edit profile, change password, and delete account. Each member has a unique email address and stores hashed password for secure authentication. Related session management is handled by {@link multi_user_todo_member_sessions}, password reset functionality by {@link multi_user_todo_member_password_resets}, and email verification by {@link multi_user_todo_member_email_verifications}.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address for authentication. Must be unique across all members.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password for secure authentication.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Member's full name for profile identification.

plainFields.name: nickname
plainFields.description: Optional nickname for display purposes.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the member account was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp for soft deletion. Null if account is active.

models.name: multi_user_todo_member_sessions
models.description: JWT session tokens for member authentication with access and refresh token support. This table tracks login sessions for authenticated members, storing connection metadata and temporal information for audit trails. Sessions are created upon successful login and terminated on logout or expiration. Each member can have multiple concurrent sessions, but all sessions are private to the member and cannot be accessed by other users.

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address from the login request.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Request URI from the login request.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer header from the login request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Session creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for session termination.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Session expiration timestamp for automatic logout.

models.name: multi_user_todo_member_password_resets

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Secure one-time use password reset token.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp after which the reset link becomes invalid.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for audit trail.

models.name: multi_user_todo_member_email_verifications
models.description:
Email verification tokens for member registration and email change confirmation.

This subsidiary table stores verification tokens generated during member account creation and email change operations. Each token is associated with a specific member and email address, with expiration time and usage tracking.

Key relationships:
- {@link multi_user_todo_members}: Each verification belongs to one member
- Tokens are one-time use, marked with used_at when consumed

Behavioral notes:
- Tokens expire at expires_at timestamp
- used_at indicates successful verification
- deleted_at supports soft deletion for audit trail

plainFields.name: token
plainFields.description: Unique verification token string.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Email address to be verified.

plainFields.name: purpose
plainFields.description: Verification purpose: 'registration' for new account creation, 'email_change' for updating member email address.

plainFields.name: expires_at
plainFields.description: Token expiration timestamp. Token becomes invalid after this time.

plainFields.name: used_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when token was successfully used for verification. Null if unused.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp for audit trail.

models.name: multi_user_todo_todo_histories
models.description:
Edit history records for todo items, storing complete snapshots of todo state at each modification. Each entry captures the values of title, description, start_date, and due_date at the time of edit, along with the timestamp and the member who made the change. History entries are sorted from most recent to oldest for chronological review. When a todo is permanently deleted, all associated history entries are also removed.

Key relationships:
- Created by {@link multi_user_todo_members} - the member who made the edit

Behavioral notes:
- Append-only: History entries are never modified after creation
- Soft delete support: deleted_at allows recovery if needed
- Privacy isolation: Only the todo owner and system can access history

foreignFields.name: multi_user_todo_member_id
foreignFields.description: Member who made the edit's {@link multi_user_todo_members.id}. Tracks the actor responsible for this history entry.

plainFields.name: changed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the edit occurred. Used for chronological sorting of history entries (most recent first).

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Snapshot of the todo's title at the time of edit. Null if title was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Snapshot of the todo's description at the time of edit. Null if description was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: start_date
plainFields.description: Snapshot of the todo's start date at the time of edit. Null if start date was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: due_date
plainFields.description: Snapshot of the todo's due date at the time of edit. Null if due date was not changed in this edit.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Record creation timestamp.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Record last update timestamp.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft deletion timestamp. Allows recovery of deleted history entries.
